title: Jake Barber takes Michael Herrera underground at Edwards AFB
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jake Barber takes Michael Herrera underground at Edwards AFB, about unspecified at Edwards Air Force Base, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Michael Herrera, who's another UFO whistleblower, >> he, I believe, has an interesting story where Jake Barber, after getting into contact with him at this Greer event, takes him underground to this Edwards Air Force base and possibly shows him some sort of UFO or craft.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Michael Herrera, another UFO whistleblower, has a story in which Jake Barber, a man who says he worked on recovering crashed craft, met him at an event run by the UFO activist Steven Greer. According to Michels, Barber then took Herrera underground at Edwards Air Force Base in California and possibly showed him some kind of UFO or craft, which would mean such craft are kept there.
